method: Hand audit of complete C030y proof and replay of existing exact rational program; no independent second software implementation.

manual_checks.normalization: g(1/z)-g(1/w) divided by (1/z-1/w) equals (z/f(z))(w/f(w))(f(z)-f(w))/(z-w); extra logarithms are pure, so mixed entries agree.
manual_checks.truncation: a_7 first enters at degree six; omitted interior degree >=7 and exterior degree >=7 cannot enter the positive-degree logarithm below degree seven.
manual_checks.all_equations: First row fixes b_1,...,b_5. Remaining residuals are (X^2-1)/2, XY, XZ+Y^2/2, XZ+Y^2+(X^3-1)/3, for X=b_1,Y=b_2,Z=b_3.
manual_checks.actual_branches: X=1 requires tau*S_2=0; X=-1 requires tau*S_2=2 and then Y=0, contrary to Y=-tau*S_3<0. No zero division.
manual_checks.general_elimination: X^2=1 and XY=0 give Y=0, then XZ=0 gives Z=0, then X^3=1 gives X=1. tau>0 gives S_2=S_3=S_4=0.
manual_checks.sufficiency: For S_2=S_3=S_4=0 the displayed reciprocal with arbitrary b_0 and real S_5,S_6 gives all nine entries. tau=0 is compatible but excluded.
manual_checks.inherited_signs: L025 gives absolute convergence/reality. L018/L026 give |Im alpha|<1/2 and |Re alpha|>4; positive-real representatives have |arg alpha|<1/8. For k<=6, |2k arg alpha|<3/2<pi/2. L021/L024 ensure a nonempty zero multiset via nonpolynomiality. See C030y audit1255 for full reasoning and source qualifications.
